scope: standalone exterior-only recognition prototype; not connected to WorldChunkBuilder, the facade catalog, compiler, registry, or loader

target.canonical_name: US Dept of Labor Job Corps Dormitory Building 369

supports: outermost WSW long elevation and SSE end corner
alternating broad multi-lite and narrow windows
green eyebrow elements on many broad windows
warm long wall field against a muted blue-gray end or stair volume and thin dark-green eave
ground broad bays mixing glazing, opaque blue-gray panels or doors, and base vents
does_not_support: exact bay dimensions, count, or alternation period
exact stair volume dimensions or projection
opposite long elevation, recessed wings, rear end, or entrances
interior, occupancy, substrate, product, or color sample

supports: exact source binding, mapped public scope, dated cue inventory, confusion set, and nonclaims

mapped_public_region.accepted_material_scope: existing accepted warm homogeneous material remains exact to runs 0..5 only
mapped_public_region.prototype_module_scope: standalone-only five-row opening, eyebrow, base, eave, and minimal SSE-end stair hierarchy; no live placement or acceptance imported

protected_region.policy: lifted exact-XZ exterior shell and roof closure in a quiet neutral non-claim surrogate only; no facade modules, color transfer, labels, or inferred schedules

production_inference_m.height_rationale: five observed occupied tiers times the project convention of 3.0 m per tier; selected inside the prior 2.5-3.3 m visual estimate and not asserted as measured

accepted_warm_field.application: lifted exact-XZ shell runs 0..5 only; retains existing component acceptance but does not prove the prototype

inferred_blue_gray.application: minimal standalone-only stair/end mass and mapped ground panels; source-supported hierarchy, unsurveyed scalar/color

inferred_green_trim.application: mapped eave and broad-opening eyebrows only; source-supported hierarchy, unsurveyed scalar/color

opaque_opening.application: exterior opaque proxy for mapped glazing/openings and vents; no transparency or interior claim

opening_frame.application: mapped opening surrounds and multi-lite divisions only

neutral_roof.application: exact-XZ source roof triangulation lifted to inferred five-tier landing height; no roof-product claim

collision_contract.hero_shell: all 72 exact source wall run XZ edges with exact terrain-following bottom vertices and inferred 18.39 m top
collision_contract.hero_roof: all exact source roof XZ vertices and source triangulation lifted to inferred 18.39 m landing height
collision_contract.structural_collision: triangle-congruent with every structural visible element
collision_contract.decorative_facade_relief: noncolliding shallow exterior modules with the hero wall collision immediately behind
collision_contract.spray_ownership: none in standalone prototype; a future live adapter must explicitly assign exact wall ownership and may not inherit prototype collision

future_live_integration_seam.matcher: fail-closed exact wall+roof pair for w291189926
future_live_integration_seam.required_live_behavior: intercept the exact wall and roof together before generic visual or collision creation, remove the fallback 6 m representation completely, and recreate explicit spray ownership only on the validated hero wall collision
future_live_integration_seam.forbidden_partial_attach: never overlay prototype visuals over the retained fallback wall or roof collider; never attach only one member of the pair

blocked_claims: as-built or surveyed height, tier spacing, bay dimensions, bay count, alternation period, opening profile, stair geometry, eave depth, material substrate, or color sample
opposite long elevation, recessed chains, rear end, entrance design, roof product, interior, occupancy, or operable glazing
address, source ID, label, hue alone, or location as a recognition cue
recognition or believability acceptance before independent bar-raiser review
live attachment, registry entry, generated-data edit, or acceptance transfer from the warm material trial
